review_candidates.title: Senior Software Developer, Automation Platform (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: Company Overview NACOS Marine delivers advanced navigation, automation, and control systems for vessels worldwide. Our integrated solutions help ship owners and operators improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability at sea. With proven reliability, innovative technology, and dedicated support, we enable smarter maritime operations. Let’s shape the future of maritime technology together. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer, Automation Platform (m/f/d) to play a leading role in defining and developing the next generation of NACOS Marine's automation platform. In this strategic role, you will drive the architecture of a scalable, modular, and future-ready marine automation platform that supports vessel automation projects worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Program Management, and multidisciplinary engineering teams across multiple locations, you will translate business and technical requirements into robust platform architecture while mentoring development teams and driving technical excellence throughout the product lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Define and evolve the architecture for NACOS Marine's next-generation automation platform, ensuring scalability, modularity, reliability, and long-term maintainability Design and implement advanced automation platform solutions for maritime applications, balancing performance, reliability, and operational requirements Lead platform architecture decisions, including technology selection, architectural trade-offs, and system design principles Evaluate, validate, and integrate new technologies, tools, and development methodologies to continuously improve platform capabilities Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to cross-functional development teams across multiple locations Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and design workshops to ensure alignment across engineering teams Collaborate closely with Product Management and Program Management to ensure architectural decisions support business objectives, delivery milestones, and product strategy Develop and maintain technical architecture documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through implementation Mentor software engineers and architects, promoting best practices, code quality, and technical excellence Promote modern software engineering practices, including developer productivity tools, automation, and continuous improvement Key Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial or process automation, including experience in system architecture or technical leadership Proven experience designing distributed, real-time automation platforms and software architectures Strong knowledge of automation systems, runtime environments, configuration management, and hardware/software integration Proficiency in C/C++ and C# for automation platform development Experience with Git-based version control and modern software development practices Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, and scalable platform development Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical direction across multidisciplinary teams Strong analytical mindset with the ability to balance technical quality, business needs, and delivery objectives Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and assisted software development Fluent in English, both written and spoken Why choose us and why we'd choose you? At NACOS Marine, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of maritime automation by defining the architecture of our next-generation automation platform. You'll work alongside highly skilled international teams on innovative technologies that directly impact vessels operating around the world. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous innovation. If you are passionate about building scalable software platforms, mentoring engineering teams, and driving architectural decisions that make a lasting impact, we would love to hear from you.
